Installed image: ELF:bcc6789e6fb477b785a2b02be80b8b1b054ff88c
Source: configured native-elf-images.json reference, dwarfort, Linux 53.16.
This directory contains offline source extraction, not game execution results.

Ghidra C and its original instructions are retained for these complete unwind owners:
  17cda80..17d92b0: journal renderer, including agreement cards and detail fields
  17db9b0..17dd94e: agreement list constructor and its order title branches
  17db8d0..17db9a8: sorted person-index insertion used by the constructor
  14f13e0..14f1a87: month-name writer, 12 cases and empty default

elf-switches.tsv retains every selector and alias in these owners. The broader
renderer also contains the neighboring journal tabs; those switch entries and
instructions are retained to preserve the original function's control flow.
elf-display-fields.tsv records addst return sites and their supplying formatter.
Nearby literals in that file are assembly context, not inferred field contents.

Agreement title source and clipping:
  17db9b0 stores full list_name at agreement_entryst+20.
  17cda80 copies list_name to p_list_name at +60 and resizes it to 58 bytes.
  addst at 17cfece returns to 17cfed3 and receives the +60 string.
  The previously configured 13cfed3 belongs to an unrelated indirect-call loop.
  Translation recovers +20 only from the proven +60 writer and matching bytes.
  Journal headings, collapsed headings, the Tasks strip and search share one
  complete title grammar; the original counter remains an independent field.

Subject switch: 0..17, default produces no additional subject label.
  0 JoinParty: reason switch below
  1 DemonicBinding: World Joining Agreement
  2 Residency: Residency Agreement
  3 Citizenship: Grant of Citizenship
  4 Parley: Parley Arrangement
  5 PositionCorruption: Corruption
  6 PlotStealArtifact: Artifact Theft
  7 PromisePosition: Promise of Position
  8 PlotAssassination: Assassination Plot
  9 PlotAbduct: Abduction Plot
 10 PlotSabotage: Sabotage Plot
 11 PlotConviction: circumstance 0 -> Foiled Bribery Conspiracy,
                    2 -> Foiled Corruption Conspiracy,
                    3 -> Foiled Embezzlement Conspiracy;
                    other circumstances do not assign a label
 12 Location: Build Structure
 13 PlotInfiltrationCoup: Infiltration Plot
 14 PlotFrameTreason: Framing Plot
 15 PlotInduceWar: War Starting Plot
 16 OfferService: Offer Service
 17 RetrieveArtifact: Retrieve Artifact

JoinParty reason switch (selector range 0..42, all aliases retained):
  0: Insurrection with <person>; Overthrow Agreement
     <person/You>, agreed to join, <person/you>, in insurrection against,
     <group>, thereby freeing, <site>
  1: Adventure with <person>; Adventuring Agreement
     <person/You>, agreed to adventure with, <person/you>,
     wherever the journey might lead
  2: Guided by <person>; Guide Agreement
     <person/You>, agreed to guide, <person/you>, to, <site>
 23: Rescue <person>; Rescue Agreement
     <person/You>, agreed to join, <person/you>,
     in order to be brought safely away from, <site>
 24: Aid rescue with <person>; Aid Rescue Agreement
     <person/You>, agreed to join, <person/you>, in order to rescue,
     <person/you/somebody unknown>
 39: The bound service of<person>; Bound Servitude
     <person/You>, was bound to serve, <person/you>, by invocation of True Name
 42: Entertain people with <person>; Entertainment Agreement
     <person/You>, agreed to entertain people with, <person/you>, throughout the world
 default: constructor may retain the unprefixed person name; detail reason
          switch emits no reason prose. Native type information selects the
          personal-name resolver for this title, including label-shaped names.

Party resolution branches:
  Each relevant subject looks up both party IDs and their first historical
  figure. Missing/empty party vectors or unresolved figures omit that prose.
  A participating player is drawn as You/you; other people use 12c58d0.
  The rescue target uses its figure name, you, or somebody unknown.
  Groups use a278f0; sites use a27cd0; artifacts use a0d8c0.
  These are independent typed fields, not dictionary guesses from their spelling.

OfferService / RetrieveArtifact:
  Expanded OfferService: <requester/You>, requested that, <recipient/you>,
                         make an offer of service to, <group>
  Compact OfferService:  <requester/You>, requested that, <recipient/you>,
                         serve <group> (two addst writes on the same row)
  Expanded RetrieveArtifact: <requester/You>, asked that, <recipient/you>,
                            retrieve, <artifact>, optional from <site>,
                            optional for <group>
  Compact RetrieveArtifact: <requester/You>, asked that, <recipient/you>,
                           retrieve <artifact> (two writes on the same row)
  Other subject types have their subject label; this renderer does not emit
  extra diplomatic/intrigue prose for those types.

Completion:
  JoinParty end_year != -1 adds Done: to the title, marks the subject heading,
  and emits Agreement concluded followed by a separately drawn calendar date.
  The date has st/nd/rd/th day branches, the shared twelve-month switch and year.
  The month switch default appends an empty month; numeric fields are preserved
  with a translated unknown-month label. No cancellation sentence is emitted
  by this agreement renderer.

Order record branches (native virtual kind 7, 8, 9):
  7: Order: Kill <actor>; Kill, <actor>
  8: Order: Cause trouble for <group>; Cause trouble for, <group>
  9: Order: Drive off <group> from <site>; Drive members of, <group>, out of,
     <site>, or compact Drive, <group>, from, <site>
  Actor/commander source is a10320 and may describe an unnamed native actor.
  Issuer: An order from, <actor>.
  States: Finish reporting in / Complete: report back / Not yet completed.
  A concluded associated agreement can add Agreement concluded.
  Missing references retain the corresponding command prefix or empty field.
  Centering labels: Centered on commander / Centered on target; shared location
  branches also include Centered on location / first heard / last heard.

Runtime handling:
  Fixed fields live under Adventurer log agreement field in local-overrides.tsv.
  Type labels separately identify the card when its title is unavailable.
  Original addst return sites select Person / Actor / Group / Site / Artifact /
  Date / Type. Independent rows retain their native positions and colors;
  adjacent writes on one row are translated together with per-field colors.
  Complete retained titles cover native 58-byte truncation and the finished
  prefix. Unknown reason/crime branches preserve the absence of native text.
